high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "onevision999" and "did.u.know__". The post features a close-up photograph of a hand holding several cowrie shells, which are small, oval-shaped seashells with a distinctive pattern. The shells are brown with white spots and are being held against a background filled with more of these shells. The text overlay on the image reads: "Ancient Indian currency that you must have not seen ever: 1) Kaudi." This suggests that the cowrie shells were used as a form of currency in ancient India.
